|removal_version = 3.25.0 }} '''Ancestral Warchief''' is a [[skill]] that creates an [[Ancestor Totem]] which will [[attack]] enemies with melee [[Area of effect|AoE]] slams while the character stands close to it. Being near it also increases the [[character]]'s damage. Ancestral Warchief has an attack speed multiplier of 90%. ==Skill functions and interactions== *'''Fortify''': Linking {{il|Fortify Support}} to Ancestral Warchief will cause the totem, and not the player, to gain fortification on melee hit. Stats that let you gain fortification in certain conditions related to attacking (e.g. on hit, on melee stun) are also inherited by the totem. *'''Multiple Totems''': Melee damage buff does not stack when multiple totems are summoned. *'''Totem Attack Range''': The range at which the totem strikes is affected by the [[Range#Weapon Range|weapon range]] of the equipped weapon and modifiers to weapon range.{{cite web|date=August 31, 2017|title=PoE 3.0.1.C Ancestral Warchief & Range|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dc7WBveqEXg|publisher=YouTube|accessdate=August 31, 2017}} *'''Area of Effect''': Modifiers to area radius affect both the range at which the totem strikes, as well as the radius of the attack. *'''Activation''': The totem is active as long as the player remains within a 80 [[Distance|unit]] radius of it. Initial activation also requires line of sight with the player, but this can be broken once the totem has become active.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1676002/filter-account-type/staff/page/5#p14700017 ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Melee
Damage |c1_header = x% more Melee Damage while Totem is Active |c1_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% more Melee Damage while Totem is Active |c1_pattern_value = %d%% }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Alternate skill effects== Ancestral Warchief had the following [[alternate skill effect]]s: {{Item table |where =items.name = "Void Ancestral Warchief" OR items.name = "Iron Maiden Ancestral Warchief" |description=1 |large=1 |responsive=1 }} ==References== {{reflist}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Melee Totem Skills have been removed. * Existing versions of the {{il|Replica Dragonfang's Flight}} Unique Item will now provide mod for another Gem. }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now provides 0-30% increased Activation range, instead of 0-20% increased Totem Damage. }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Now deals 166% of Base Damage, and has 166% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 20 (previously 133%). }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Now deals base damage equal to, and has an added damage effectiveness of, 110% at gem level 1 (from 100%), up to 133% at gem level 20 (from 123%). * Now has an attack speed multiplier of 90% (rather than 10% less attack speed). }} {{Version history table row|2.5.0| * Ancestral Warchief now does 10% less damage at all levels. * Fixed behaviour with the center of the slam being significantly further away than the totem's melee range. * The skill now has +10 melee range at all levels, and the slam will always be centered at melee range away from the totem. }} {{Version history table row|2.3.0| * Introduced to the game }} {{Version history table end}} {{Navbox Skills}}
